diagnosis: Deduplication chooses the lexicographically lowest random subscription/server ID after active/manual priority. Adding a new overlapping source can therefore steal inactive canonical records and prune their saved order/exclusions.
correction: Persist the elected canonical IDs by identity/import key in config/system/server-canonical-owners.json. Preserve an existing elected owner while it is present; active then manual priority remain higher. Seed the map during existing runtime-prepare deduplication before WebUI admission. Do not introduce quality history or network refresh.
safety: Validate the map as a regular non-symlink JSON document; reject malformed or ambiguous map state before deletion. Update only the durable map atomically after successful deduplication. Keep duplicate backups and global admission unchanged.
scopeBoundary: This stabilizes ownership during addition/refresh of overlapping sources. It does not promise automatic network recreation when the deliberately removed canonical source is deleted.
validation: Older elected source survives a lexically earlier newly added source
Deleting only rejected duplicate source leaves original records
Rebuild independent A/B after final source correction
previousCandidateSuperseded: P90 artifacts remain immutable evidence but are not publishable after P95 acceptance failure.
